_notes._: agentHours are wall-clock hours of agent work per package (brief reading, building, self QA, one revision round) with a human reviewer; humanMinutes.standard is reviewer time on the standard package. Estimates, refined by yield data from closed jobs.
_notes.landing_page_web: One responsive page with copy, built and checked at 390, 768 and 1440 px plus one revision; deluxe adds sections and a form, premium multi-page.
_notes.web_app_dev: A small CRUD app with auth and deploy needs design, tests and integration; review of data model and security keeps the reviewer longest.
_notes.ai_automation_chatbot: Prompting, tool wiring, evaluation on sample conversations and deployment; the evaluation set is most of the time.
_notes.data_crawling: One site scraper with pagination, export and a rerun guide; anti-bot handling pushes deluxe and premium.
_notes.excel_macro: One workbook macro or script with test data and usage notes; the client's file quirks dominate.
_notes.detail_page_design: One long product page image from supplied copy and photos, rendered and checked at mobile width; taste review by the human.
_notes.logo_brand: Several concepts, one refined set and source files; the human picks and critiques, so reviewer time is high for the price.
_notes.thumbnail_banner: One image at fixed sizes from a template; fast to make, the human checks text and taste.
_notes.photo_editing: Background removal or retouch on a few images with local tools; minutes per image.
_notes.ppt_card_news: About 10 slides or cards from supplied content, layout and export; deluxe and premium scale with slide count.
_notes.video_editing: Cuts, captions and music on a short clip with render and review passes; render and review time dominate.
_notes.translation_ko_en: About one page of Korean to English with a human proofread for tone and terms.
_notes.copywriting: One page of sales or landing copy with two variants and the slop gate; the human checks claims.
_notes.blog_writing: One researched post of about 2,000 Korean characters with sources and the slop gate.
_notes.kmongGig: Category labels the kmong /my-gigs/new form shows for a listed service: root (1st level) and sub (2nd level), plus third when the form asks for a 3rd level.
_notes.kmongForm: Values for the kmong gig edit form of that category, read from the live form 2026-10-25: meta is the 주요 특징 selects by label, packageSelects and packageChecks are package rows by label with one value per STANDARD, DELUXE, PREMIUM column (작업 기간 and 수정 횟수 come from the listing), scope is what each package covers and is handed to the copy writer so the package text and the form agree.
_notes.freelancerJob: The Freelancer.com job (skill) whose active fixed-price projects are the service's market, matched by its exact name through the public jobs API; a service without one has no job there that sells the same deliverable.
_notes.upworkSpecialty: The Upwork profile category and specialty (create-profile categories step, read from the live wizard 2026-10-25) that sells the same deliverable; Upwork takes one category and one to three specialties, so a service without one is not offered there.
_notes.wishketField: The 위시켓 project field (the pf filter label on /project/) whose 외주 projects are the service's market; only fields that sell the service's deliverable are mapped, so broad buckets such as 그래픽ㆍ영상 등 and 기획서ㆍ제안서 등 stay out.
_notes.fiverrQuery: The Fiverr gig search whose first 30 gigs are the service's market; detail_page_design has none, since Fiverr sells no long Korean product detail page.
_notes.delivery: Who delivers the service: agent (the default when absent) runs its recipe in a job; operator means the operator does the work, so the service has no recipe and no job run, and a paid job is handed to the operator (src/orders/run.mjs). An operator service is answered only on platforms whose config platforms.<id>.services lists it.
_notes.questions: What a reply asks before quoting an operator-delivered service, read into the decision prompt.
_notes.operatorSteps: Steps of an agent-delivered service the operator does himself after acceptance (its recipe's user-handoff steps that make or deploy something), named in the decision prompt as his so a quote does not promise them as the agent's work. The delivery waits until fsw job handoff records each one.
_notes.game_dev: A small 2D web game: one core loop with menus, checked on a phone and a desktop; deluxe adds levels and saves, premium a backend or a store build. The reviewer plays every build, so reviewer time is the highest in the catalog. 숨고's 게임 개발 guide prices a whole job.
_notes.mobile_app_dev: A small app for Android and iOS from one Expo React Native codebase: a few screens, local or hosted data and tests; deluxe adds sign-in and a backend, premium push notifications and payments. The job sandbox has neither the Android SDK nor a Mac, so the recipe hands the Android release build to the operator after acceptance and asks for his Mac at the iOS build step; store submission runs under the customer's developer accounts. 숨고's 안드로이드 개발 guide prices it, since one service samples one guide and the Android build is the one the agent hands over without the operator's Mac; its iOS 개발 label maps here through the descriptor. 크몽's 모바일 앱 category (602) is its listing market.
_notes.erp_dev: A small business management system delivered as a web app: records for one business area (items, customers, orders or stock), roles, reports and a spreadsheet import; deluxe covers two or three linked areas, premium an outside integration such as a tax invoice or shop API. The data model and permissions keep the reviewer longest. 숨고's ERP 개발 guide prices it; 크몽 has no ERP category, so it has no kmongCategory.
_notes.lesson_tutoring: A subject lesson the operator teaches in sessions, online or in person. humanMinutes.standard is one 60-minute session and agentHours are zero, since the agent only answers and quotes. 숨고's 프로그래밍/코딩 레슨 guide publishes only an hourly average, which prices one session.
